producer_version: 3.5.x, 4.1.x, 4.2.x (exact patch build per file not independently confirmed beyond the header's own declared major.minor version)
creation_steps: In each of three genuine, separately installed Ant Movie Catalog versions (3.5.x, 4.1.x, 4.2.x): created a new catalog and saved it immediately, unmodified (the three empty-*.amc files). Separately, in the 4.1.x and 4.2.x installations only, added one movie via the application's own Add Movie action without filling in any field, then saved (the two one-movie-*.amc files) -- there is no 3.5 one-movie file in this set. No field was ever edited on that added movie; its only non-default content is the creation timestamp AMC itself records.
provenance: Contributed directly to this repository by its owner from locally run, licensed Ant Movie Catalog installations, specifically to give this port genuine multi-version native-format evidence for the first time (see docs/decisions.md ADR-0001 and docs/PORT_AUDIT.md's P0 evidence gate). Not independently authenticated beyond the file contents and the owner's own account of how they were produced.
expected_contents: Five genuine native catalogs with no personal data: three empty catalogs (3.5, 4.1, 4.2 -- 0 movies, blank owner/mail/site/description) and two one-movie catalogs (4.1, 4.2) each holding a single blank, never-edited movie (every string field empty, every optional integer field unset, checked=True as AMC's own default for a newly added movie). Found and fixed a real reader/writer bug in this port (docs/PORT_AUDIT.md finding 38): the blank movie's year, length, media_count, video_bitrate, and audio_bitrate previously read back as the literal integer -1 (upstream's own 'no value' sentinel, confirmed in the checked-in Delphi source's TMovie.Reset in `Movie Catalog/movieclass.pas`) instead of being normalized to Python `None` the way this port's own Movie model expects; the native writer had the mirror-image bug, writing plain 0 instead of upstream's own -1 for an unset field.
